pages.text: $(o)A fallen knight wrapped in fire, waiting in the $(l)Burning Arena$().$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Its sword hits hard enough to drop a careless caster. Healers stay back; fighters roll through the big swings.$(br2)It grows fiercer as it weakens. Save your strongest spells for the end.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Everyone nearby earns a $(item)Void Shard$(): Eyes of Ender need it, and it raises your world tier to Summit.
